HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   B. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.

3. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.

4. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

11. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. B — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A — Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. D — Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of African Civilisations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
